# Image Vault

> A bilingual, Apple-inspired personal image workstation: owner-only admin, public-by-link image URLs, temporary QR phone upload, and a browser-only GitHub Pages showcase.

## Give this to an implementation Agent

Copy this one-line request. The Agent reads the remote implementation brief and builds in the user's current workspace; it does not need to clone this repository:

```text
复刻 Image Vault 图片工作站到当前工作区，先读取并遵守：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rethymus/image-vault/main/AGENT_PROMPT.md
```

English:

```text
Reproduce the Image Vault workstation in the current workspace. Read and follow: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rethymus/image-vault/main/AGENT_PROMPT.md
```

## Required behavior

- `vault-admin`: Cloudflare Access owner-only React/Vite workstation;
- `vault-upload`: public, token-only, short-lived QR upload Worker;
- R2 is the private manager's source of truth;
- all R2 list pages are read, sorted by upload time, and rendered;
- private counts come from the returned asset array, never mock data;
- public demo counts come from the current browser array and reset only on refresh;
- light/dark/system appearance, Chinese/English copy, responsive desktop/mobile UI;
- no secrets in Vite variables, source files, screenshots, or chat;
- no cloud mutation before explicit owner approval.

## Stop conditions

Stop and report missing values before creating a bucket, deploying Workers, changing Access, deleting assets, rotating real links, or requesting secrets. Use disposable images only.
